name: myRev_append
prelude:
def myRev : List α → List α
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => myRev xs ++ [x]
statement: theorem myRev_append (xs ys : List α) : myRev (xs ++ ys) = myRev ys ++ myRev xs
proofs:
induction xs with
  | nil => simp [myRev]
  | cons x xs ih => simp [myRev, ih, List.append_assoc]
  have rev_eq (zs : List α) : myRev zs = zs.reverse := by
    induction zs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons z zs ih => simp [myRev, ih, List.reverse_cons]
  simp [rev_eq, List.reverse_append]
strategies: Structural induction on xs, reassociating append.
Identify myRev with library reverse in a helper, then use reverse_append.
